card.name: Punctuation after a label or number
card.fires_on: Single punctuation marks or spaces that follow a short label or number and come right before a continuing term, such as a colon after a drive letter, a % or ° sign before a range, a space after A 2A or α 2, or a closing parenthesis after a dose.

modes.label: Space or hyphen after receptor label
modes.description: The gap after a short receptor name or subtype, just before a word like receptor or adrenergic.

modes.label: Symbol after a number
modes.description: A percent sign, degree sign or closing parenthesis right after a number or dose, before a continuing word or range.

modes.label: Colon after a drive letter
modes.description: A colon following a single capital letter naming a computer drive.
